1887.name: Ground shake timer
desc: Frames left of the screen-shaking effect. Set by Thwomp landings, Bowser and Koopa Kid stomps, falling
columns, Sumo Bro stomps, Yoshi ground stomp, layer 2/3 smashes. Counted down once per frame in the in-level
game mode; while nonzero the layer 1 displacement at $1888/$1889 is made to wobble.
Values: 0 = no shake; typical starts $20 (most bosses), $30 (Sumo Bro, ground pound), $50 (layer 3 smash), 5 (Yoshi).

1888.name: Layer 1 Y shake displacement, low
desc: Low byte of the vertical offset added to layer 1's scroll while the ground shakes ($1889 is the high byte).
Computed each frame in game mode 14 from the shake timer $1887, added to $001C in the NMI scroll setup and
to the IRQ split position. Sprites that draw relative to the screen (fireballs, falling columns, parallax) add it
too so they shake with the ground. Cleared to 0 at level start.

1889.name: Layer 1 Y shake displacement, high
desc: High byte of the layer 1 shake offset ($1888 is the low byte). Zeroed in game mode 14 each frame before the
offset is recomputed, and added to the BG1 vertical scroll high byte in the NMI scroll setup.

188B.name: Mario Y offset on Yoshi
desc: Vertical offset used when drawing Mario while he rides Yoshi. The Yoshi sprite main routine sets it to 6;
it is cleared when there is no Yoshi, when an item is spawned from Yoshi's mouth, and in Peach's walk states.
Read by Mario's OAM drawing code.

188D.name: Screen X working copy (parallax)
desc: Temporary storage used by the parallax background sprite drawing: the screen X low byte is stored here and
shifted with ROR repeatedly to derive scrolled positions. Not meaningful outside that routine.

188F.name: Bonus game blocks hit
desc: Bonus game (sprite 82) counter of blocks hit. Cleared by the bonus game init, incremented each time the
bonus game block routine finishes all nine blocks, which marks the game as finished.

1890.name: Bonus game match counter
desc: Counts matching lines in the bonus game: incremented by the match counting routine, decremented by the
keyhole main routine, cleared by the bonus game init. Used to decide the outcome of the bonus game.

1891.name: P-balloon timer
desc: Frames of P-balloon flight left. Set to $FF when Mario takes a P-balloon, decremented in the carried-sprite
routine; when it reaches zero the balloon deflates. Cleared at level end.
Values: 0 = no balloon active.

1892.name: Cluster sprite type
1892.kind: byte table, one per cluster sprite slot (index X)
desc: Cluster sprite number for each slot; 0 = slot free. Set by the cluster spawners (types 3, 5 and 8 in the samples:
Boo ceiling/bat groups, ring of Boos, bonus 1-ups) and cleared when the sprite goes away or is collected.
The cluster loop dispatches on it. Also used as a per-slot timer for Sumo Bro lightning flames (set to 6 to
activate) and as the extended sprite number table by the keyhole routine (set to 1), indexed by Y.

18A7.name: Tile touched by sprite from side
desc: Map16 tile number a sprite hit when its horizontal block check found a solid tile. Written by the sprite
horizontal block check, read by the kicked shell routine and Chuck physics to react to specific tiles.

18A8.name: Falling column state
18A8.kind: byte table, one per column slot (index X)
desc: State of each falling column in the Bowser/Koopa Kid castle style falling-column effect. Indexed by X in the
falling columns routine. $01:CE28 also increments the first entry from the wall Koopa Kid states.

18AA.name: Falling column fall speed
18AA.kind: byte table, one per column slot (index X)
desc: Y speed of each falling column; the routine adds (value >> 5) + 1 each frame so the column accelerates.
Cleared by the wall Koopa Kid states.

18AC.name: Yoshi tongue/swallow timer
desc: Hold timer for what Yoshi has in his mouth, and the tongue state. Set to $FF when the tongue starts,
cleared when an item leaves the mouth, when baby Yoshi swallows a caught sprite, and in baby Yoshi stunned logic.
Read by Yoshi's draw routine to pick the mouth frame.
Values: 0 = nothing held / tongue idle.

18AD.name: Yoshi walk frame
desc: Index of Yoshi's current walk animation frame while Mario is on him. Updated in the Yoshi on-Mario update as
([$18AD] - 1) mod 3 and used to look up the frame to show.

18AE.name: Yoshi tongue wind-up flag
desc: Set to 6 by Yoshi's main routine when the tongue timer $14A3 equals $10 and it is not already set, starting the
wind-up. Nonzero makes the draw code use tile $0C instead of the normal mouth tile. Cleared by Yoshi contact and smoke puff routines.

18AF.name: Yoshi mount timer
desc: Set to $0C when Mario is put on Yoshi (Put Mario on Yoshi), read by the Yoshi on-Mario update to time the mounting animation.

18B3.name: Berry tile Y position, high
desc: High byte of the Y position of the tile Yoshi is eating a berry from. Stored in the eat-berry routine and read back
when the berry is replaced with a tree tile; also used by the berry/silver coin block helper.

18B5.name: Mario in winged cage flag
desc: Set to 1 by the (unused) winged cage routine when Mario is in the cage. Cleared by Mario's block and slope collision.

18B6.name: Sprite scratch (step/offset)
desc: General-purpose scratch used by several sprite routines: step counter cleared at level load, saved Y
position for Lakitu's fishing line and cloud, the Boo aiming Y offset ($10, or $20 for Big Boo), and the growing pipe tile.
Meaning depends on the routine that sets it; do not treat as persistent.

18B8.name: Cluster/special sprites active flag
desc: Set to 1 when cluster sprites are loaded, by the keyhole routine (bonus game, probably) and while Sumo Bro lightning
flames burn. Read in the sprite loop setup ($01:80B5), probably to decide whether the extra sprite handlers run.

18B9.name: Generator number
desc: Which sprite generator is active, 0 = none. Set from the generator sprite number minus $CA (sprites $CB-$D9) at init,
or directly (the Whistlin' Chuck sets 9). Dispatched on by the generator routine, e.g. 5/6 = left/right dolphins,
2/3/4 = para-enemies (goomba, bomb, both). Cleared at level end, by Init Lakitu, and by Turn off generator.

18BA.name: Cluster sprite group counter
desc: Counts cluster sprite groups/phases: incremented per group in Load cluster sprites and when a fading Boo phase
advances, decremented by the Ring of Boos routine. Shared among those cluster routines.

18BC.name: Skull raft speed
desc: Speed of the floating skull raft. Set to 0 at init and $0C when Mario steps on it, after which it starts to move.

18BD.name: Mario lock timer
desc: Frames Mario is held in place. The Koopa Kid boss sets it to $28 on landing; Mario's per-frame handling decrements it.
Values: 0 = not locked.

18BE.name: Mario on rope flag
desc: Set while Mario hangs on a line guide rope; cleared by the line guide engine each frame before riding is rechecked,
read by Mario's normal animation handling.

18BF.name: Sprite shared state flag
desc: Used by several unrelated sprites. Cleared by Init Lakitu and Init Magikoopa, which also tests it as a
Magikoopa kill flag (probably). Incremented by Stop sprite respawning; read by Lakitu clouds, Fishin' Boo,
layer 3 smash, and cluster Boos. Purpose unclear.

18C0.name: Sprite respawn timer
desc: Time until a sprite is respawned. Set to $FF by Lakitu's cloud logic (with $18C1 = $1E, Lakitu) and by Erase
sprite off-screen; zeroed to stop respawning. The per-frame misc handler counts it down and respawns the sprite in $18C1.
Values: 0 = nothing to respawn.

18C1.name: Sprite to respawn
desc: Sprite number to respawn when $18C0 expires. Set to $1E (Lakitu) by Lakitu's cloud logic and by Erase sprite
off-screen; read by the per-frame misc sprite handlers.

18C2.name: Mario riding Lakitu cloud flag
desc: Incremented by Lakitu's cloud logic (probably meaning Mario is on the cloud). Cleared each frame in the sprite
loop setup and by the scripted walk. Tested by the screen scroll routine and Mario's pose selection.

18CD.name: Bounce sprite overwrite index
desc: Index of the bounce sprite slot to overwrite when none is free. Decremented in Find bounce sprite slot
and read by Set up bounce sprite and spawn item.

18CE.name: Turn block spin timer
18CE.kind: timer table, indexed by bounce sprite slot
desc: Spin timer of a turn block bounce sprite. Set to $FF when spawned, decremented by bounce sprite 07.

18D2.name: Star kill counter
desc: Counts enemies killed in a row by star power or similar, used to pick the score/1-up. Incremented by star kills,
Wiggler, and Rex deaths; cleared on a normal Mario-sprite contact.

18D4.name: Red berry count
desc: Red berries Yoshi has eaten; incremented in the tongue state routine and reset to 0 at 10, at which point Yoshi
lays a sprite ($74). Pairs with $18D5 and $18D6.

18D5.name: Pink berry count
desc: Pink berries eaten; reset to 0 at 2, at which point sprite $6A is created and $18DE is started.

18D6.name: Berry type eaten
desc: Type of berry Yoshi is eating: 1 = red, 2 = pink, 3 = green (tile minus $44). Set by the berry helpers,
consumed (and cleared) by the Yoshi tongue states to update $18D4/$18D5 or add time.

18D9.name: Enter-castle animation timer
desc: Animation timer for the enter-castle sequence, set by EnterCastleAni ($B0 or $7F) and read by the animation
and its drawing routine. Also written in the scripted walk (purpose unclear).

18DC.name: Yoshi ducking flag
desc: Set when Yoshi is ducking/looking down; cleared by the spawn item/on-Mario update. Read by Mario's fireball, Put Mario
on Yoshi, the tongue logic and the eat-berry routine.

18DD.name: Chained score index
desc: Index into the score values for chained scoring (e.g. consecutive kills). Read and incremented by power-up behaviour,
read by the level-end coin sprite, cleared at level end; set to 2 by the berry helpers (silver P-switch, probably).

18DE.name: Yoshi reward timer
desc: Counts down in Yoshi physics. Set to $20 when Yoshi finishes eating enough berries (with the reward sprite in $18DA).
Read by the Yoshi main routine.

18DF.name: Yoshi slot plus 1
desc: Yoshi's sprite slot + 1, set each frame by the Yoshi sprite main routine (and the level-end coin routine), 0 = no Yoshi
this frame. Cleared at the start of the sprite loop; copied to $18E2 as last frame's value.

18E0.name: Lakitu cloud lifetime
desc: Lifetime counter for Lakitu's cloud. Cleared at Init Lakitu, set to $FF when Lakitu is killed, read by the cloud logic.

18E2.name: Yoshi slot plus 1 (last frame)
desc: Yoshi's sprite slot + 1 as of the previous frame (copied from $18DF at the sprite loop start), 0 = no Yoshi.
Tested by sprite-from-block spawning, Yoshi egg and item spawning to see if Yoshi exists. Also reused in the ending scenes.

18E3.name: Coin game cloud coin count
desc: Coins collected from the coin game cloud: reset on the first frame and when Mario is hurt, incremented by the smoke puff contact.

18E4.name: Pending 1-Up counter
desc: Lives waiting to be awarded. Score sprites add to it, the level end tally and status bar increment it, and the per-frame
misc handler gives one life at a time, playing the 1-Up sound, waiting $23 frames ($18E5) between each.

18E5.name: 1-Up delay timer
desc: Delay between awarding queued lives from $18E4: loaded with $23 after each life, counted down by the misc handler.
Cleared when a score sprite adds to $18E4.
